$comment: Lithuania catalog research — compiled 2026-09-20 from official university pages (see docs/56-lithuania-catalog-research.md for sources and open items). Every entry carries `confidence` and `sourceUrl` so it can be loaded into UniversityMetadata and shown with a freshness label. Fields marked null were not published on the source page and must be confirmed before a student sees them. All fees are EUR, per academic year, for non-EU students, 2026/2027 unless stated.

qualificationRecognition.note: Foreign qualifications must be recognised. KTU and VMU run the recognition inside their own admission (VMU: within 20 working days); VU and VILNIUS TECH ask for SKVC recognition or assess under SKVC guidelines. Budget 3–4 weeks for it.

documentLegalisation.nonHagueCountries: Double legalisation: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the issuing country, then Lithuanian MFA (universities sometimes handle the second stamp). Pakistan is non-Hague.
documentLegalisation.pakistan: Vilnius University additionally requires HEC + Ministry of Foreign Affairs attestation on Pakistani certificates.
documentLegalisation.translation: Everything not in English or Lithuanian needs an official translation; certified copies of originals.

commonDocuments.note: Valid ≥ 1 year (VILNIUS TECH) or ≥ 2 years (VMU) from application; issued within last 10 years for TRP.
Legalised + translated; with full transcripts (Biology & Chemistry shown for LSMU).
IELTS/TOEFL/PTE/Duolingo/Cambridge; usually not older than 2 years (LCC).
For the residence permit — every country lived in > 6 months in the last 2 years; valid 6 months; legalised.
For the residence permit — see migration.financialProof.
For the residence permit — ≥ €10,000 cover, whole Schengen area, no franchise.

migration.route: Degree students need a Temporary Residence Permit (TRP). Applied for in MIGRIS (migracija.lt) with biometrics at a VFS Global centre abroad, or — where there is no centre — after arrival at a Migration Department office. Study in Lithuania's official guidance says both national visa D and TRP should be applied for BEFORE travel; universities issue a 'mediation letter' that must be used within 7–14 days.
migration.pakistanNote: OPEN RISK — Lithuania has no embassy in Pakistan and no VFS centre accepting Lithuanian TRP applications there. Short-stay C visas for Lithuania are handled by the Embassy of Hungary in Islamabad (+92 51 207 7800). The exact D-visa/TRP route for a Pakistani student must be confirmed with the Migration Department and the admitting university before SNZ promises anything. Several universities (LSMU) explicitly note Pakistan is not on the VFS list.
migration.financialProof: 2026: €577 per month × 12 + €1,153 return costs (Vilnius University figure); VMU 2025 guide: €520/month = €6,228/year, doubled (€12,456) plus notarised commitment if a parent's account is used. VILNIUS TECH states €7,500/year in a Lithuanian bank.
migration.stateFee: €80 (decision within 2 months) or €320 expedited (1 month); VFS service charge €40–€160; applicants must apply within the mediation letter validity.

livingCosts.note: Secondary sources put living costs at roughly €500–€800 per month; LCC residence halls from €575 per semester. Not to be shown as a fact without a dated source.

deadlines.note: Not published on the pages fetched. Final graduation documents due before 20 Aug; scholarship applicants by 1 Jul. Decision within 30 working days of a complete file; accept within 7 working days; pay first year within 15 calendar days.

bachelor.note: Secondary sources give IELTS 5.5–6.0 for bachelor; VU keeps an approved list of methods — confirm per programme on vu.lt language-skills page.

master.note: Secondary sources give IELTS 6.5–7.0 for master.

academic.general: Completed secondary education (bachelor) / bachelor's degree (master); certified copies + official translations.
academic.pakistan: Bachelor: only applicants with 75% or higher total marks qualify; HSSC + SSC with marks statements; HEC and MOFA attestation. Master: CGPA 3.00 or 75%; some programmes require the OMPT exam (55% minimum). Pakistani applicants cannot apply with predicted grades.
academic.egypt: Secondary certificate 65%+; master grade 'Good' or better.

tuition.note: Ranges from secondary sources (study.eu / shiksha). Per-programme fees must be read from each programme page on vu.lt before display.

deadlines.note: Applications open 5 Jan 2026, close 20 Apr 2026 (search-result snippet from vilniustech.lt; confirm on the application-procedure page). Tuition payment deadlines: 15 Sep (autumn), 15 Feb (spring). Tuition + registration may be refunded if visa/TRP is refused.

master.note: Master minimums not separately confirmed; general page cites B2 / IELTS 5.5 / TOEFL iBT 72.

academic.general: High-school certificate with CGPA ≥ 60%. Entrance score = weighted Mathematics + Physics/science/social subject + English. Study gap must not exceed 3 years. Architecture requires an entrance exam.
academic.pakistan: Pakistan, Bangladesh and Nepal applicants must pass the OMPT Mathematics exam with ≥ 60% for university programmes.
academic.financialNote: University states students must hold ≥ €7,500/year in a Lithuanian bank account for living expenses.

universities.name: Lithuanian University of Health Sciences (LSMU)
universities.depositNote: Non-EU: deposit equal to half the yearly tuition for Medicine, Odontology, Pharmacy and Veterinary Medicine; a full year's tuition for all other programmes. Refund rules to be confirmed.

deadlines.note: Applications opened 1 Nov 2025. Entrance test: online interview a few days before a 90-minute written test — Biology + Chemistry (30 MCQs each), or Mathematics + Biology for Psychology; results next day. Test waived for Nursing, Physiotherapy, Occupational Therapy, Dental Hygiene (bachelor) and Applied Public Health, Advanced Nursing Practice (master) with strong relevant grades.

bachelor.note: Page text lists 'IELTS above 5.5', 'PTE 55–67', 'Duolingo 95', 'CEFR B1'; the TOEFL figure printed ('4.0') is not credible — confirm. An English test is given during admission if no certificate.

academic.general: Legalised matriculation certificate and transcripts showing Biology and Chemistry; entrance test. Masters: legalised degree + transcripts.
academic.pakistan: Non-Hague: double legalisation via Ministry of Foreign Affairs. LSMU notes non-EU students cannot use a national D visa since 1 Jul 2023 and must obtain a TRP through VFS Global — Pakistan is not on that list (see crossCutting.migration).
academic.scholarships: None for English-taught programmes — all self-funded.

programmes.name: Medicine
programmes.tuitionNote: Years I–III €12,800; years IV–VI €13,300. Integrated master's.

deadlines.note: Applications open 1 Jan 2026; 24 Jul 2026 is the deadline for EU/EFTA applicants and countries with a VFS centre or no TRP need — applicants from other countries have an EARLIER deadline that must be confirmed (mruni.eu was unreachable during research).

academic.general: Not fetched — site unreachable during research. Fields: law, psychology, public governance, business, communication.

universities.name: ISM University of Management and Economics

deadlines.note: 'Visa regime countries' (Pakistan included) must apply by 31 May 2026. Application fee waived during early admission.

academic.note: Same tuition for EU and non-EU at bachelor level.

deadlines.note: Two intakes: August (fall) and January (spring). Non-EU applicants needing a permit should use the general deadline (15 Mar for fall, 15 Sep for spring). Decision within 10 working days. Application fee waived until 15 Jan 2026; amount otherwise not stated.

bachelor.note: Certificate not older than 2 years; waiver for native speakers / a year of study in an English-speaking country.

academic.general: Selection: 40% grades from the last three years of high school, 30% English, 30% interview (online). Liberal-arts, American-style curriculum.
academic.financialAid: Need-based aid 10–80% of tuition (9 of 10 applicants approved); 16 scholarships covering 50–100%; average aid €1,652/year; up to 90% of tuition coverable.

universities.name: Klaipėda University
universities.applicationFeeNote: €75 for EU and Eastern Partnership countries.

deadlines.note: Spring 2027 intake (start Feb 2027) deadline 1 Nov 2026 for Management; Social Work and Crisis Intervention (BA) and Business Management; Regional Governance; Healthcare Management (MA). Autumn deadlines not fetched. Tuition is refunded if visa/TRP is rejected.

academic.general: Application → academic commission → online interview if shortlisted → pay tuition → Letter of Acceptance. Apostilled documents required. 25 English-taught programmes (14 bachelor, 10 master).
